title: Bain’s Bridge Data Centres Seeks Upsized Loan of $6.6 Billion
text:
Bain Capital-owned Bridge Data Centres is in talks with banks to increase the size of a loan from $2.8 billion to about $6.6 billion for its Malaysia operations, Bloomberg reported. The raise would be one of the largest debt financing deals in Asia’s data centre industry.
